name: Evoker (Wizard Subclass - 2024)
description: Your studies focus on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid.
source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Wizard Class

3.name: Evocation Savant
3.description: Choose two Wizard spells from Evocation school (L2 or lower), add to spellbook free. When gaining new spell slot levels, add one Evocation spell of that level free.

3.name: Potent Cantrip
3.description: Damaging cantrips affect creatures even if they avoid the brunt. Missed attack or successful save -> target takes half cantrip damage (if any), no additional effects.

6.name: Sculpt Spells
6.description: When casting an Evocation spell affecting other creatures you see, choose a number of them (1 + spell level). Chosen creatures auto-succeed saves, take no damage if normally half.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.description: Add Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

14.name: Overchannel
14.description: When casting a L1-5 Wizard spell dealing damage, deal max damage. First time no penalty. Subsequent uses before Long Rest: take 2d12 Necrotic per spell level (ignores Res/Immunity), increases by 1d12 per use.
